name: RSWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Sat, by the fed's own founding conceit, above every real federation's own world title — the WWF's, the NWA's, the USWA's — as the one belt every organization agreed to recognize. Bruno Sammartino held it from before the surviving record begins through its own end, turning back Andre the Giant in the Memphis card's triple main event and standing billed to defend it again against Curt Hennig on a Tampa card whose own results never survive.

name: RSWA World Tag-Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Valiant Brothers from before the surviving record begins, sidelined from the Memphis card by an injury angle — a beatdown from the Road Warriors, with their own manager left "serious but out of danger" — and billed to defend the belts in a cage against Stan Hansen and Terry Gordy on a Tampa card whose own results never survive.
